project.name: Web Royale
project.purpose: Modern features, arenas and future online development base

cards.name: Knight
cards.description: A tough melee fighter. The Barbarian's handsome, cultured cousin. Rumor has it that he was knighted based on the sheer awesomeness of his mustache alone.

cards.name: Archers
cards.description: A pair of lightly armored ranged attackers. They'll help you take down ground and air units, but you're on your own with hair coloring advice.

cards.name: Goblins
cards.description: Four fast, unarmored melee attackers. Small, fast, green and mean!

cards.name: Giant
cards.description: Slow but durable, only attacks buildings. A real one-man wrecking crew!

cards.name: P.E.K.K.A
cards.description: A heavily armored, slow melee fighter. Swings from the hip, but packs a huge punch.

cards.name: Minions
cards.description: Three fast, unarmored flying attackers. Roses are red, minions are blue, they can fly, and will crush you!

cards.name: Balloon
cards.description: As pretty as they are, you won't want a parade of THESE balloons showing up on the horizon. Drops powerful bombs and when shot down, crashes dealing area damage.

cards.name: Witch
cards.description: Summons Skeletons, shoots destructo beams, has glowing pink eyes that unfortunately don't shoot lasers.

cards.name: Barbarians
cards.description: A horde of melee attackers with mean mustaches and even meaner tempers.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: Slow but durable, only attacks buildings. When destroyed, explosively splits into two Golemites and deals area damage!

cards.name: Skeletons
cards.description: Three fast, very weak melee fighters. Surround your enemies with this pile of bones!

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.description: Tough melee fighter, deals area damage around her. Swarm or horde, no problem! She can take them all out with a few spins.

cards.name: Skeleton Army
cards.description: Spawns an army of Skeletons. Meet Larry and his friends Harry, Gerry, Terry, Mary, etc.

cards.name: Bomber
cards.description: Small, lightly protected skeleton who throws bombs. Deals area damage that can wipe out a swarm of enemies.

cards.name: Musketeer
cards.description: Don't be fooled by her delicately coiffed hair, the Musketeer is a mean shot with her trusty boomstick.

cards.name: Baby Dragon
cards.description: Burps fireballs from the sky that deal area damage. Baby dragons hatch cute, hungry and ready for a barbeque.

cards.name: Prince
cards.description: Don't let the little pony fool you. Once the Prince gets a running start, you WILL be trampled. Deals double damage once he gets charging.

cards.name: Wizard
cards.description: The most awesome man to ever set foot in the Arena, the Wizard will blow you away with his handsomeness... and/or fireballs.

cards.name: Mini P.E.K.K.A
cards.description: The Arena is a certified butterfly-free zone. No distractions for P.E.K.K.A, only destruction.

cards.name: Spear Goblins
cards.description: Three unarmored ranged attackers. Who the heck taught these guys to throw spears!? Who thought that was a good idea?!

cards.name: Giant Skeleton
cards.description: The bigger the skeleton, the bigger the bomb. Carries a bomb that blows up when the Giant Skeleton dies.

cards.name: Hog Rider
cards.description: Fast melee troop that targets buildings and can jump over the river. He followed the echoing call of \qHog Riderrrrr\q all the way through the Arena doors.

cards.name: Minion Horde
cards.description: Six fast, unarmored flying attackers. Three's a crowd, six is a horde!

cards.name: Ice Wizard
cards.description: This chill caster throws ice shards that slow down enemies' movement and attack speed. Despite being freezing cold, he has a handlebar mustache that's too hot for TV.

cards.name: Royal Giant
cards.description: Destroying enemy buildings with his massive cannon is his job; making a raggedy blond beard look good is his passion.

cards.name: Guards
cards.description: Three ruthless bone brothers with shields. Knock off their shields and all that's left are three ruthless bone brothers.

cards.name: Princess
cards.description: This stunning Princess shoots flaming arrows from long range. If you're feeling warm feelings towards her, it's probably because you're on fire.

cards.name: Dark Prince
cards.description: Dark Prince deals area damage and lets his spiked club do the talking for him — because when he does talk, it sounds like he has a bucket on his head.

cards.name: Three Musketeers
cards.description: An elite trio of powerful, independent markswomen with perfectly coiffed helmets and bayoneted boomsticks.\n\nThey slash, shoot, and slay in the name of justice and honor.

cards.name: Lava Hound
cards.description: The Lava Hound is a majestic flying beast that attacks buildings. The Lava Pups are less majestic angry babies that attack anything.

cards.name: Ice Spirit
cards.description: Spawns one lively little Ice Spirit to freeze a group of enemies. Stay frosty.

cards.name: Fire Spirit
cards.description: The Fire Spirit is on a mission to give you a warm hug. It'd be adorable if it wasn't on fire.

cards.name: Miner
cards.description: Miner can burrow his way underground and appear anywhere in the Arena. It's not magic, it's a shovel. A shovel that deals reduced damage to Crown Towers.

cards.name: Sparky
cards.description: Sparky slowly charges up, then unloads MASSIVE area damage. Overkill isn't in her vocabulary.

cards.name: Bowler
cards.description: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks. His massive boulders roll through their target, hitting everything behind for a strike!

cards.name: Lumberjack
cards.description: He chops trees by day and hunts The Log by night. His bottle of Rage spills everywhere when he's defeated.

cards.name: Battle Ram
cards.description: Two Barbarians holding a big log charge at the nearest building, dealing significant damage if they connect; then they go to town with their swords!

cards.name: Inferno Dragon
cards.description: Shoots a focused beam of fire that increases in damage over time. Wears a helmet because flying can be dangerous.

cards.name: Ice Golem
cards.description: He's tough, targets buildings and explodes when destroyed, slowing nearby enemies. Made entirely out of ice... or is he?! Yes.

cards.name: Mega Minion
cards.description: Flying, armored and powerful. What could be its weakness?! Cupcakes.

cards.name: Dart Goblin
cards.description: Runs fast, shoots far and chews gum. How does he blow darts with a mouthful of Double Trouble Gum? Years of didgeridoo lessons.

cards.name: Goblin Gang
cards.description: Spawns six Goblins - three with knives, three with spears - at a discounted Elixir cost. It's like a Goblin Value Pack!

cards.name: Electro Wizard
cards.description: He lands with a \qPOW!\q, stuns nearby enemies and shoots lightning with both hands! What a show off.

cards.name: Elite Barbarians
cards.description: Spawns a pair of leveled up Barbarians. They're like regular Barbarians, only harder, better, faster and stronger.

cards.name: Hunter
cards.description: He deals BIG damage up close - not so much at range. What he lacks in accuracy, he makes up for with his impressively bushy eyebrows.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.description: He throws his axe like a boomerang, striking all enemies on the way out AND back. It's a miracle he doesn't lose an arm.

cards.name: Bandit
cards.description: The Bandit dashes to her target and delivers an extra big hit! While dashing, she can't be touched. The mask keeps her identity safe, and gives her bonus cool points!

cards.name: Royal Recruits
cards.description: Deploys a line of recruits armed with spears, shields and wooden buckets. They dream of ponies and one day wearing metal buckets.

cards.name: Night Witch
cards.description: Summons Bats to do her bidding! If you get too close, she's not afraid of pitching in with her mean-looking battle staff.

cards.name: Bats
cards.description: Spawns a handful of tiny flying creatures. Think of them as sweet, purple... balls of DESTRUCTION!

cards.name: Royal Ghost
cards.description: He drifts invisibly through the Arena until startled by an enemy...then he attacks! After a few seconds of resting in peace, he becomes invisible again. Zzzzzz...

cards.name: Ram Rider
cards.description: Together they charge through the Arena; snaring enemies, knocking down towers ... and chewing grass!?

cards.name: Zappies
cards.description: Spawns a pack of miniature Zap machines. Who controls them...? Only the Master Builder knows.

cards.name: Rascals
cards.description: Spawns a mischievous trio of Rascals! The boy takes the lead, while the girls pelt enemies from behind... with slingshots full of Double Trouble Gum!

cards.name: Cannon Cart
cards.description: A Cannon on wheels?! Bet they won't see that coming! At low health, it becomes a Cannon not on wheels.

cards.name: Mega Knight
cards.description: He lands with the force of 1,000 mustaches, then jumps from one foe to the next dealing huge area damage. Stand aside!

cards.name: Skeleton Barrel
cards.description: It's a Skeleton party in the sky, until all the balloons pop... then it's a Skeleton party on the ground!

cards.name: Flying Machine
cards.description: The Master Builder has sent his first contraption to the Arena! It's a fast and fun flying machine, but fragile!

cards.name: Wall Breakers
cards.description: A daring duo of dangerous dive bombers. Nothing warms a Wall Breaker's cold and undead heart like blowing up buildings.

cards.name: Royal Hogs
cards.description: The King's personal pets are loose! They love to chomp on apples and towers alike - who let the hogs out?!

cards.name: Goblin Giant
cards.description: This jolly green Goblin Giant stomps towards enemy buildings. He carries two Spear Goblins everywhere he goes. It's a weird but functional arrangement.

cards.name: Fisherman
cards.description: His Ranged Attack can pull enemies towards him, and pull himself to enemy buildings. He's also mastered the ancient art of 'Fish Slapping'.

cards.name: Magic Archer
cards.description: Not quite a Wizard, nor an Archer - he shoots a magic arrow that passes through and damages all enemies in its path. It's not a trick, it's magic!

cards.name: Electro Dragon
cards.description: Spits out bolts of electricity hitting up to three targets. Suffers from middle child syndrome to boot.

cards.name: Firecracker
cards.description: Shoots a firework that explodes upon impact, damaging the target and showering anything directly behind it with sparks. This is what happens when Archers get bored!

cards.name: Mighty Miner
cards.description:
Walk softly ... and carry a big drill!

This Champion deals increasing Damage to his target and can switch lanes to escape combat or change attack plans.

This makes him not only the mightiest, but also the sneakiest Miner in the Arena.

cards.name: Elixir Golem
cards.description: Splits into two Elixir Golemites when destroyed, which split into two sentient Blobs when defeated. Each part of the Elixir Golem gives your opponent some Elixir when destroyed!

cards.name: Battle Healer
cards.description: With each attack, she unleashes a powerful healing aura that restores hitpoints to friendly troops.

cards.name: Skeleton King
cards.description: The King of the undead himself. He sometimes feels lonely (could be due to his non flattering features) and will summon friends to join him in the battle even after death. Tough guys have feelings too!

cards.name: Archer Queen
cards.description: She is fast, deadly and hard to catch. Beware of her crossbow bolts and try not to blink - you might miss her!

cards.name: Golden Knight
cards.description: A warrior with luxurious hair and outstanding flexibility. Demonstrates his aerobics skills on demand.

cards.name: Monk
cards.description: Monk has spent many isolated years perfecting a new style of combat.\n\nHe fires off a 3-hit combo, with the last blow dealing extra Damage and pushing enemies back!

cards.name: Skeleton Dragons
cards.description: This pair of skeletal scorchers deal Area Damage and fly above the Arena. They also play a mean rib cage xylophone duet.

cards.name: Mother Witch
cards.description: Places a curse on enemy troops with each attack. When a cursed troop is destroyed, it turns into a building-targeting Hog that fights alongside the Mother Witch!\n\nShe also bakes great cookies.

cards.name: Electro Spirit
cards.description: Jumps on enemies, dealing Area Damage and stunning up to 9 enemy troops. Locked in an eternal battle with Knight for the best mustache.

cards.name: Electro Giant
cards.description: He channels electricity through his Zap Pack, a unique device that stuns and damages any troop attacking him within its range.\n\nDon't tell him that his finger guns aren't real! He'll zap you.

cards.name: Phoenix
cards.description: This mystical creature will be reborn as an egg when destroyed. If it hatches, it returns to the fight! What an egg-cellent ability.

cards.name: Little Prince
cards.description: Who let their nephew into the Arena?! This mischievous Royal gains Hit Speed when firing, as long as he stands still!\n\nHe may look weak, but he's always being watched over from afar...

cards.name: Goblin Demolisher
cards.description: Boom goes the dynamite! Goblin Demolisher deals area damage and explodes on death. At low health, he charges towards the nearest building.

cards.name: Goblin Machine
cards.description: Goblin Machine has two arms for melee and one big rocket for faraway targets. Who let a baby drive this thing?

cards.name: Suspicious Bush
cards.description: This invisible bush skulks towards the nearest building. Sus.\n\nIf Suspicious Bush reaches its target or gets destroyed by a spell, it surprises the enemy with Bush Goblins!

cards.name: Goblinstein
cards.description: It's ALIVE!\n\nMonster lumbers towards enemy buildings while Doctor waits to spring the trap. At the press of a button, Doctor electrifies the link between himself and Monster, frying nearby enemies!

cards.name: Rune Giant
cards.description: Need your weapons sharpened? You've come to the right place.\n\nRune Giant enchants troops closest to her, having them deal bonus damage every third attack. Only two troops can be enchanted at once.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.description: It's surprising how often she needs her axes sharpened, but then again, if you liked hitting things as fast as her, so would you.

cards.name: Boss Bandit
cards.description: The boss of the Forest Gang finally shows her face...kind of.\n\nBoss Bandit dashes to her targets and is invulnerable while dashing. When things get tough, her pair of grenades are at the ready.

cards.name: Ronin
cards.description: A wandering warrior with nowhere to be and no one he can't defeat. Ronin parries one melee attack every few seconds, reflecting even more damage than he blocked.\n\n1v1 him, we triple hog dare you!

cards.name: Minion Giant
cards.description: Minion Giant was mysteriously formed during an attempt to create the very toxin he spits out. He flies, targets buildings, and retches from range.\n\nAn experiment gone massively wrong... or exceedingly right?

cards.name: Cannon
cards.description: Defensive building. Shoots cannonballs with deadly effect, but cannot target flying troops.

cards.name: Goblin Hut
cards.description: Defensive building that spawns Spear Goblins when enemies are in range. Don't look inside... you don't want to see how they're made.

cards.name: Mortar
cards.description: Defensive building with a long range. Shoots big boulders that deal area damage, but cannot hit targets that get too close!

cards.name: Inferno Tower
cards.description: Defensive building, roasts targets for damage that increases over time. Burns through even the biggest and toughest enemies!

cards.name: Bomb Tower
cards.description: Defensive building that houses a Bomber. Deals area damage to anything dumb enough to stand near it.

cards.name: Barbarian Hut
cards.description: Building that periodically spawns Barbarians to fight the enemy. Time to make the Barbarians!

cards.name: Tesla
cards.description: Defensive building. Whenever it's not zapping the enemy, the power of Electrickery is best kept grounded.

cards.name: Elixir Collector
cards.description: You gotta spend Elixir to make Elixir! This building makes 8 Elixir over its Lifetime. Does not appear in your starting hand.

cards.name: X-Bow
cards.description: Nice tower you got there. Would be a shame if this X-Bow whittled it down from this side of the Arena...

cards.name: Tombstone
cards.description: Building that periodically spawns Skeletons to fight the enemy... and when destroyed, spawns 4 more Skeletons! Creepy!

cards.name: Furnace
cards.description: Furnace spawns one Fire Spirit at a time while dealing damage with its special cauldron brew.\n\nIt also makes great brick-oven pancakes.

cards.name: Goblin Cage
cards.description: When the Goblin Cage is destroyed, a Goblin Brawler is unleashed into the Arena! Goblin Brawler always skips leg day.

cards.name: Goblin Drill
cards.description: Building capable of burrowing underground and appearing anywhere in the Arena. Spawns Goblins one at a time until destroyed. Then spawns a few more, to make sure everything nearby has been properly stabbed.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.description: Annnnnd... Fireball. Incinerates a small area, dealing high damage.

cards.name: Arrows
cards.description: Waves of Arrows pepper a large area, damaging all enemies hit.

cards.name: Rage
cards.description: Increases troop movement and attack speed. Buildings attack faster and summon troops quicker, too. Chaaaarge!

cards.name: Rocket
cards.description: Deals high damage to a small area. Looks really awesome doing it.

cards.name: Goblin Barrel
cards.description: Spawns three Goblins anywhere in the Arena. It's going to be a thrilling ride, boys!

cards.name: Freeze
cards.description: Freezes and damages enemy troops and buildings, making them unable to move or attack. Everybody chill.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.description: Mirrors your last card played for +1 Elixir. Does not appear in your starting hand.

cards.name: Lightning
cards.description: Bolts of lightning damage and stun up to three enemy troops or buildings with the most hitpoints in the area.

cards.name: Zap
cards.description: Zaps enemies, briefly stunning them and dealing damage inside a small radius.

cards.name: Poison
cards.description: Covers the area in a deadly toxin, damaging enemy troops and buildings over time. Yet somehow leaves the grass green and healthy. Go figure!

cards.name: Graveyard
cards.description: Surprise! It's a party. A Skeleton party, anywhere in the Arena. Yay!

cards.name: The Log
cards.description: A spilt bottle of Rage turned an innocent tree trunk into \qThe Log\q. Now, it seeks revenge by crushing anything in its path!

cards.name: Tornado
cards.description: Drags enemy troops to its center while dealing damage over time, just like a magnet. A big, swirling, Tornado-y magnet.

cards.name: Clone
cards.description: Duplicates all friendly troops in the target area. Cloned troops are fragile, but pack the same punch as the original! Doesn't affect buildings.

cards.name: Earthquake
cards.description: Deals Damage per second to troops and Crown Towers. Deals huge Building Damage! Does not affect flying units (it is an EARTHquake, after all).

cards.name: Barbarian Barrel
cards.description: It rolls over and damages anything in its path, then breaks open and out pops a Barbarian! How did he get inside?!

cards.name: Heal Spirit
cards.description:
A mischievous Spirit that leaps at enemies, dealing Damage and leaving behind a powerful healing effect that restores Hitpoints to friendly troops!

R.I.P. Heal
2017 - 2020
Alas, we hardly used ye.

cards.name: Giant Snowball
cards.description: It's HUGE! Once it began rolling down Frozen Peak, there was no stopping it. Enemies hit are knocked back and slowed down.

cards.name: Royal Delivery
cards.description:
No need to sign for this package!

Dropped from the sky, it deals Area Damage to enemy troops before delivering a Royal Recruit.

The empty box is also handy for espionage.

cards.name: Void
cards.description: You shall not pass! Unless there are lot of you...\n\nCreates a field of dark magic, damaging all enemy troops and buildings within. More damage is dealt when fewer targets are in its area.

cards.name: Goblin Curse
cards.description: One does not simply reverse a curse!\n\nEnemies within the curse’s reach will take damage over time and be turned into Goblins after they are defeated.

cards.name: Spirit Empress
cards.description: Behold the Spirit Empress, the First of Her Name, Protector of Spirits, Rider of Dragons.\n\nSummon her as a hard-hitting ground troop for 3 Elixir, or atop her majestic spirit dragon for 6 Elixir.

cards.name: Vines
cards.description: Entangle the three highest hitpoint troops or buildings in the area, stunning them while dealing damage. If the troop is in the air, they'll ground them.\n\nDon't worry, they'll grow on you!

forms.name: Knight Evolution
forms.description: Not only has his facial hair gotten an upgrade, the Knight's armor has, too! Evolved Knight has a special Shield that reduces Damage unless he is attacking.

forms.name: Archers Evolution
forms.description: These Archers have been specially trained by Archer Queen herself as her personal sharpshooters. They deal more Damage to far away enemies with Power Shot!

forms.name: P.E.K.K.A Evolution
forms.description: Floats like a butterfly, stings like a bee. Evolved P.E.K.K.A has a giant soul-sucking sword that restores health after slaying her enemies.

forms.name: Witch Evolution
forms.description: Witch's Skeletons are willing to sacrifice themselves for their beloved leader, lending their souls to heal her when they're destroyed.

forms.name: Barbarians Evolution
forms.description: These Barbarians have grown stronger through Evolution!\n\nNot only do they now have glorious hair, but they also gain extra Speed and Hitspeed with each attack.

forms.name: Skeletons Evolution
forms.description: When there's no more room in Spooky Town, the dead will walk the Arena!\n\nThis Evolution is a never-ending horde, with each Skeleton summoning another with every attack!

forms.name: Valkyrie Evolution
forms.description: If you thought her battle cry was scary...wait until you see her new axe!\n\nEvolved Valkyrie draws all enemies towards her with each swing.

forms.name: Skeleton Army Evolution
forms.description: Look alive! General Gerry's Skeletons are devoted to him, becoming invisible and indestructible in his presence. But alas, an army cannot survive without its General and will perish in his absence.

forms.name: Bomber Evolution
forms.description: Bomber has discovered the art of bomb bouncing. It's like skipping stones, but much more exciting.\n\nWith his new skill, Bomber will be able to hit multiple targets in a row with one attack!

forms.name: Musketeer Evolution
forms.description: She can hit a Royal Hog from thirty tiles away!\n\nEvolved Musketeer snipes targets across the Arena in a straight line ahead of her. She has limited Sniper Ammo with increased damage. She cannot snipe Crown Towers.

forms.name: Baby Dragon Evolution
forms.description: That's a big baby! While attacking, Baby Dragon Evolution creates a gust of wind that speeds up friendly troops and slows down enemies in the area. It's a wind-win situation!

forms.name: Wizard Evolution
forms.description: Is it hot in here or is it just him?\n\nWizard is now outfitted with a fancy, fiery shield. Upon breaking, the shield explodes, dealing Damage and pushing nearby enemies back.

forms.name: Minion Horde Evolution
forms.description: The first strike against each member of Minion Horde Evolution makes it briefly invincible. Some say this mysterious veil is a result of the Dark Elixir running through their veins...

forms.name: Royal Giant Evolution
forms.description: The Royal Giant Evolution is SO royal that he shoots giant golden cannon balls. Talk about privileged!\n\nHe also protects himself with powerful Recoil Damage generated by each attack.

forms.name: Princess Evolution
forms.description: Evolved Princess fights fire with ice!\n\nEvery other attack, her icy arrows slow enemies in range. Upon defeat, the arrows are left behind to slow and damage those who dare to near them.

forms.name: Ice Spirit Evolution
forms.description: Stay frosty when Ice Spirit is about! Literally. It now infuses a target with an Ice Blast spell, which deals freezing Area Damage over time.

forms.name: Lumberjack Evolution
forms.description: When Evolved Lumberjack is destroyed, his invisible Ghost seeks vengeance as long as it's in the pool of Lumberjack's Rage.\n\nWho you gonna call?

forms.name: Battle Ram Evolution
forms.description: These Evolved Barbarians upgraded their hardware!\n\nEvolved Battle Ram deals damage and pushes enemies back during its charge. Once it connects to a building, it won't stop charging!

forms.name: Inferno Dragon Evolution
forms.description: With the new and improved InfernoTank 2.0™, Inferno Dragon Evolution keeps its beam charged and deadly even when it has nothing to melt. But even the best tank doesn't last forever.

forms.name: Dart Goblin Evolution
forms.description: It's time to blow darts and chew gum, and he's all out of gum.\n\nEvolved Dart Goblin's darts Poison the area around his target until they're destroyed. The more he attacks a target, the deadlier the Poison gets.

forms.name: Elite Barbarians Evolution
forms.description: These guys throw absolute ragers!\n\nEvery few seconds, Evolved Elite Barbarians can hurl Rage-tipped spears to distant enemies that create an enraging path for allies.

forms.name: Hunter Evolution
forms.description: Be very, very quiet.\n\nEvolved Hunter throws a net that stuns the closest troop. If that troop is in the air, it'll ground them.

forms.name: Executioner Evolution
forms.description: That's not an axe... This is an axe!\n\nEvolved Executioner's axe deals more damage to enemies in close quarters and pushes them back.

forms.name: Royal Recruits Evolution
forms.description: Royal Recruits have been taking lessons from Prince. Once their shields have been broken, they will begin an epic charge!

forms.name: Bats Evolution
forms.description: What's cooler than Bats? VAMPIRE BATS. These creatures of the night heal with each attack and can increase their Hitpoints past their maximum!

forms.name: Royal Ghost Evolution
forms.description: Once visible, Royal Ghost summons two Souldiers to guard his spirit, dealing damage in their summoning. When they've rested long enough, they'll disappear just like their leader.\n\nWho doesn't love a good hauntourage!

forms.name: Mega Knight Evolution
forms.description: Mega Knight’s other great love, besides his mustache, is boxing.\n\nWith every other attack, this Evolution uppercuts his target and sends them flying toward the nearest enemy Crown Tower.

forms.name: Skeleton Barrel Evolution
forms.description: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? Is it...two Barrels full of Skeletons?\n\nWhen Evolved Skeleton Barrel drops its Barrels, it deals Death Damage and spawns Skeletons. Upon taking enough Damage, a Barrel will drop early.

forms.name: Wall Breakers Evolution
forms.description: Who let Wall Breakers into the gunpowder stores? They've run off with more explosives!\n\nIt's double trouble with this Evolution as they continue their attack on foot if their barrel is destroyed!

forms.name: Royal Hogs Evolution
forms.description: These guys are hogging the spotlight!\n\nEvolved Royal Hogs take flight towards the nearest building and will fall to the ground once they reach their destination or, if attacked, dealing landing damage.

forms.name: Goblin Giant Evolution
forms.description: The bigger the sack, the bigger the... amount of Goblins spawned!\n\nAt low health, this Evolution will spawn a stream of Goblins. Take him out quickly!

forms.name: Electro Dragon Evolution
forms.description: Can't stop, won't stop!\n\nEvolved Electro Dragon's attack will chain between targets infinitely and can hit the same target more than once. Additional Chained Attacks won't stun enemy targets, and they will not hit Crown Towers.

forms.name: Firecracker Evolution
forms.description: Some Firecrackers just want to watch the world burn. Especially this one!\n\nThe Firecracker Evolution shoots a supercharged rocket that deals Damage per second to any enemies caught in her sparks.

forms.name: Goblin Barrel Evolution
forms.description: Evolved Goblin Barrel is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re going to get.\n\nWhenever Evolved Goblin Barrel is cast, a Decoy Barrel - filled with Decoy Goblins! - is thrown in the opposite lane.

forms.name: Zap Evolution
forms.description: This Evolution comes gently zapping, zapping at your Arena floor...\n\nGet two Zaps for the cost of one, with the second Zap hitting a larger area!

forms.name: Giant Snowball Evolution
forms.description: A rolling snowball gathers no Troops...unless it's Evolved!\n\nEvolved Giant Snowball gathers enemy Troops and rolls forward before breaking, which frees and slows the Troops down.

forms.name: Cannon Evolution
forms.description: When this Evolution is deployed, it barrages both sides of the Arena, dealing damage and knocking enemies back.\n\nWho doesn't love the smell of gunpowder in the morning?

forms.name: Mortar Evolution
forms.description: The new & improved Mortar uses patented Goblin Delivery Technology to rain noisy green destruction upon the Arena!

forms.name: Tesla Evolution
forms.description: This Evolution is quite shocking!\n\nBad jokes aside, the evolved Tesla sends out an intermittent Electro Pulse, dealing Damage to any enemies caught in it.

forms.name: Furnace Evolution
forms.description: All fired up! When it's hot and attacking, Evolved Furnace summons Fire Spirits even faster from hat to hearth.

forms.name: Goblin Cage Evolution
forms.description: If you smell what the Goblin Brawler is cooking!\n\nEnemies that get close to the Evolved Goblin Cage are pulled inside and take damage over time until the enemy or cage is destroyed.

forms.name: Goblin Drill Evolution
forms.description: Let's play Whack-A-Drill!\n\nWhen deployed near enemy Crown Towers, Goblin Drill submerges and reappears around the tower as it takes damage, spawning Goblins each time.

forms.name: Hero Knight
forms.description: Imagine a mustache so magnificent it lures enemies to their doom!\n\nHero Knight takes great care to wax his shield and mustache in equal measure, so as to always twist the tide of battle in his favor.

forms.name: Hero Goblins
forms.description: A single gobble of Goblins is never enough!\n\nHero Goblins are far too clever to go into battle without backup, so the final one to fall drops an unassuming banner that signals the second wave.

forms.name: Hero Giant
forms.description: A titan amidst Goblins...a Hero among men.\n\nHero Giant wastes no time showing his enemies who's boss and who's lost on their journey to the King Tower.

forms.name: Hero Balloon
forms.description: These skyward Skellies were never satisfied while six feet under!\n\nAeri and her Skeleton crew are known for their semi-well-crafted wings which allow them to dive-bomb without breaking any bones.

forms.name: Hero Valkyrie
forms.description: Whirl power! Hero Valkyrie has gone round and round the Arena, getting whipped into shape and chopping down troops with an axe that won't quit.\n\nNow, she's ready for her final test at the gates of Valkhalla.

forms.name: Hero Musketeer
forms.description: Hero Musketeer has a new best friend: the boom building! This scrappy guy shoots fast and hard, making her boomstick suuuuuper jealous.

forms.name: Hero Wizard
forms.description: After a decade of demolishing King Towers, Hero Wizard has learned to wield fire for flight!\n\nHis wings were forged in flame and fortune, but they're mysteriously cool to the touch.

forms.name: Hero Mini P.E.K.K.A
forms.description: Hero Mini P.E.K.K.A has finally perfected his pancake recipe by speeding up cooking time with each attack!\n\nStacks on stacks on stacks!

forms.name: Hero Ice Wizard
forms.description: After months of ice-olation, with little magic and snowone to talk to, Hero Ice Wizard is colder than ever. His frozen friends became formidable allies in the Arena.\n\nAnd the icing on top? Evolved Princess won't even know what hit her.

forms.name: Hero Dark Prince
forms.description: Like his rider, Rhino has endured many a battle. Now that he and Dark Prince have found each other, they can break through any tower, or Skeleton, together.

forms.name: Hero Bowler
forms.description: This globetrotter and his boulder needed new records to break.\n\nAfter baseball broke the bleachers and football flattened all the Goblins, they found their way onto the court. From there, it was nothing but net!

forms.name: Hero Ice Golem
forms.description: In a chilling return to the Arena, Hero Ice Golem keeps enemies at bay with a brain-freezing blizzard!\n\nThe only things he has to fear are fireballs and a hot summer's day.

forms.name: Hero Mega Minion
forms.description: In an Arena full of uncertainty, Hero Mega Minion wants to make sure he can get to the right place in just the nick of time.\n\nLearning to shift through the shadows doesn't happen overnight!

forms.name: Hero Magic Archer
forms.description: With every pinecone a target and every branch a new vantage point, Hero Magic Archer was favored to be Forest Gang's first Hero.\n\nBeing Boss Bandit's right hand comes with a few perks!

forms.name: Hero Berserker
forms.description: Don't poke the bear... or underestimate her! The cry of battle runs so deep in her bones that it's released a spirited beast capable of unbearable things.\n\nHero Berserker is bearly holding it together!

forms.name: Hero Tombstone
forms.description: They may have lost a brother to the army, but Perry, Sherrie, Carrie, Jerry, and Mort are forever loyal to their Queen.

forms.name: Hero Barbarian Barrel
forms.description: They see him rollin', they hatin'!\n\n No one clears the path like Hero Barbarian Barrel, who willingly gave up his rock music career for the resilience of a second roll.

forms.name: Mighty Miner
forms.description:
Walk softly ... and carry a big drill!

This Champion deals increasing Damage to his target and can switch lanes to escape combat or change attack plans.

This makes him not only the mightiest, but also the sneakiest Miner in the Arena.

forms.name: Skeleton King
forms.description: The King of the undead himself. He sometimes feels lonely (could be due to his non flattering features) and will summon friends to join him in the battle even after death. Tough guys have feelings too!

forms.name: Archer Queen
forms.description: She is fast, deadly and hard to catch. Beware of her crossbow bolts and try not to blink - you might miss her!

forms.name: Golden Knight
forms.description: A warrior with luxurious hair and outstanding flexibility. Demonstrates his aerobics skills on demand.

forms.name: Monk
forms.description: Monk has spent many isolated years perfecting a new style of combat.\n\nHe fires off a 3-hit combo, with the last blow dealing extra Damage and pushing enemies back!

forms.name: Little Prince
forms.description: Who let their nephew into the Arena?! This mischievous Royal gains Hit Speed when firing, as long as he stands still!\n\nHe may look weak, but he's always being watched over from afar...

forms.name: Goblinstein
forms.description: It's ALIVE!\n\nMonster lumbers towards enemy buildings while Doctor waits to spring the trap. At the press of a button, Doctor electrifies the link between himself and Monster, frying nearby enemies!

forms.name: Boss Bandit
forms.description: The boss of the Forest Gang finally shows her face...kind of.\n\nBoss Bandit dashes to her targets and is invulnerable while dashing. When things get tough, her pair of grenades are at the ready.
